name: Example: Twists and Slides
author: byo-pop examples
description: Other moves. A twist, as in Bejeweled Twist, turns the four gems around a corner: click where four gems meet. A slide, as in Chuzzle, drags a whole row or column along; it stays only if it makes a match. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Moves
settings.help: With swaps and twists, a click on a gem swaps and a click where four gems meet twists.

settings.label: Right click twists back
settings.help: A right click turns the four gems counter-clockwise; a left click always turns them clockwise.

settings.label: Slide snap (hundredths of a second)
settings.help: How long a released slide takes to snap into place or slide back.
